simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַוָּל (H5767) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַוָּל (ʻavvâl) means evil (morally) First listed occurrence: Job 18 21.

definitions.full: H5767. avval עַוָּל noun masculine unjust, unrighteous one ; — especially of oppressive ruler Zeph 3:5 ; Job 18:18 ; 27:7 (|| רָשָׁע ), 29:17 ; 31:3 (|| אָ֑וֶן מֹּעֲלֵי ); probably also 16:11 (for עֲוִיל ᵑ0 , so Di; || רְשָׁעִים ). I. [ עוֺלָה ] see II. עול . II. עוֺלָה see עלה . עוֺלָל עוֺלֵל, see II. עלל . עוֺלָם see עלם .
